brief:
Approximately 350 children remain imprisoned in Israeli detention facilities, the Shehab Wire reported, facing starvation and medical and psychological torture. The number has grown amid systematic escalation in violations since the onset of the war on Gaza.

The detained children endure conditions that rights groups describe as abusive, with no indication of imminent release or improved circumstances in the facilities.
